title: Exa Webset Item
description: A single item in an Exa Webset — a curated, enrichable collection of web results scoped to a specific query, vertical (companies, people, news, research), or domain.

source.description: Source URL or domain for the item.

properties.description: Structured properties extracted for the item — schema varies by vertical (e.g. companyName, industry, headcount, person name, role, email).

enrichments.description: Results of enrichment runs applied to the item.

evaluations.description: LLM evaluations applied to the item (e.g. relevance, qualification, scoring).
